The Mission

Having benefited immensely from the open source community, LibreScienceTool is my way of giving back. I believe that scientific tools and knowledge should be freely accessible to researchers, students, and enthusiasts worldwide.

All projects are released under permissive licenses—use them, modify them, or make them entirely your own. No strings attached. If you find them useful, feel free to support the project through donations, but the tools will always remain free and open.
